decks.notes: Utilizing the powerful UrzaTron lands to quickly ramp up mana, this deck focuses on controlling the game through various artifacts and powerful Planeswalkers like Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon. The deck also includes a diverse range of threats such as Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Kozilek, Butcher of Truth to quickly close out games. With access to a variety of abilities, the deck aims to disrupt opponents' strategies while also presenting a fast and formidable win condition.

The deck focuses on using the card Indomitable Creativity to manipulate the top of the library in order to cheat out powerful threats like Archon of Cruelty and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. Teferi, Time Raveler and Spell Pierce provide disruption while Wrenn and Six and Dwarven Mine help ramp and generate tokens. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and Prismatic Ending offer additional removal options, with Expressive Iteration providing card advantage. The mana base consists of fetch lands and shock lands to ensure consistency in casting the spells needed for the combo to go off smoothly.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on fast, aggressive creature plays and burn spells to quickly deplete the opponent's life total. The deck includes efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending, as well as disruptive cards like Blood Moon to hinder the opponent's mana base. The companion, Obosh, the Preypiercer, provides a consistent source of additional damage. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of early creature pressure and direct damage spells.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive plays, utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Seasoned Pyromancer, Grief, and Fury to apply early pressure and disrupt the opponent's hand. The deck also includes utility spells like Lightning Bolt, Terminate, and Thoughtseize to control the board and remove threats. The inclusion of cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Feign Death allows for graveyard interaction and additional ways to trigger powerful abilities. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm and outpace the opponent with its aggressive creatures and disruptive spells.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat powerful creatures into play from your deck, such as Archon of Cruelty. By sacrificing tokens created by Dwarven Mine and creatively manipulating your deck with cards like Wrenn and Six and Expressive Iteration, you can overwhelm your opponent with unexpected threats. Using Prismari Command and Unsubstantiate for control and Unholy Heat for removal, this deck aims to disrupt your opponent's strategy while setting up your own combo win condition. The inclusion of Fable of the Mirror-Breaker adds an extra layer of creativity and unpredictability to your plays.

The key strategy of this UR Aggro deck is to aggressively control the board with cheap removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, while utilizing efficient threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent to quickly close out the game. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Spell Snare and Spell Pierce to disrupt opponents' game plans and protect your own threats. The inclusion of card draw spells like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble ensures a consistent stream of threats and answers, while Counterspell provides additional protection for your key cards.

The deck focuses on combining different cards to create unique and powerful interactions, utilizing Indomitable Creativity to bring out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty early in the game. It also includes cards like Wrenn and Six for additional value and consistency. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Inquisition of Kozilek while setting up its own win condition through a combination of spells and creatures. The use of cards like Persist and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker adds layers of complexity and versatility to the combo strategy.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to turn tokens created by Dwarven Mine into powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty. It also utilizes Teferi, Time Raveler to protect key combo pieces and disrupt opponents' strategies. The inclusion of Wrenn and Six helps to ensure consistent land drops and the deck also has some removal options with Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm opponents with powerful threats.

The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach to cast spells from the graveyard, enabling combos and creating explosive turns. It includes efficient spells like Lightning Bolt and Expressive Iteration to control the board while cards like Mishra's Bauble and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer help generate card advantage. Teferi, Time Raveler disrupts opponents' strategies, while Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional mana support. The deck aims to quickly assemble key pieces, creating a powerful synergy between graveyard recursion and efficient spells to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on disrupting opponents with counterspells while using efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent to apply pressure. It also utilizes cards like Blood Moon to disrupt mana bases and Unholy Heat for removal. Expressive Iteration and Consider help with card selection and finding threats quickly. The deck aims to control the game tempo through its disruptive elements and close out games quickly with aggressive creatures and burn spells.

The key concept of this deck is to use an aggressive strategy with goblins as the main creature type. The deck focuses on playing low-cost creatures like Memnite and Goblin Bushwhacker, and using cards like Kuldotha Rebirth and Goblin Grenade to quickly generate tokens and deal damage. The deck also includes cards like Reckless Bushwhacker and Dragon's Rage Channeler for additional burst damage potential. Additionally, the deck features cards like Mishra's Bauble and Manamorphose to generate card advantage and mana acceleration. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of goblins and deal significant damage quickly.

The deck focuses on quickly putting out artifact creatures and using artifact synergy to power them up and overwhelm the opponent. It includes cards like Cranial Plating and Memnite to boost creature power, as well as cards like Springleaf Drum and Thought Monitor to generate card advantage. Key cards like Urza's Saga and Darksteel Citadel help establish a strong board presence, while also providing mana acceleration. The deck aims to win through a combination of aggressive creature attacks and efficient card draw, making it a powerful Aggro - Affinity archetype in Modern 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on aggressively casting spells with cascade, allowing you to cast powerful cards for free while overwhelming your opponent with speed and efficiency. By utilizing cards like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent, you can quickly build a board presence and apply pressure to your opponent. Additionally, cards like Dead / Gone and Misty Rainforest provide versatility and card advantage, giving you the edge in longer matchups. With a mix of counter magic and creature threats, this deck is designed to disrupt your opponent's game plan while deploying threats of your own.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo of Puresteel Paladin, Colossus Hammer, and Sigarda's Aid to equip a massive creature with a one-hit kill potential. Stoneforge Mystic and Steelshaper's Gift help search for the necessary equipment pieces, while Memnite and Ornithopter provide quick and cheap creatures to equip. Inkmoth Nexus serves as an alternate win condition with infect damage, and Urza's Saga helps tutor for key pieces. The deck is designed to be fast, efficient, and lethal, aiming to quickly overwhelm opponents with its powerful combo potential.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo of equipping the Colossus Hammer onto a creature like Inkmoth Nexus or Gingerbrute, allowing for a powerful and unexpected lethal attack. The key idea is to efficiently tutor for the necessary pieces with Stoneforge Mystic and Urza's Saga while protecting the combo with cards like Spell Pierce and Giver of Runes. With Puresteel Paladin and Sigarda's Aid providing additional support, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a sudden, unstoppable assault that can end the game in just a few swings.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts and control elements to generate value and control the game. It includes key cards like Urza, Lord High Artificer, Thopter Foundry, and Sword of the Meek to create an engine that generates Thopter tokens. The deck also includes control elements like Metallic Rebuke, Teferi, Time Raveler, and Spellskite to disrupt opponents' strategies. With access to powerful artifacts and control elements, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents in a long game.
